title: Airwallex wordmark
description: A bold, tightly set company name with a small orange-red mark before it, in two sizes (header and footer).
notes: the mark is any icon (a lucide icon works); it takes the highlight colour
name: airwallex-wordmark

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark before the name (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: href
props.description: where it links to; plain text when not set

props.name: size
props.description: md: the header's 24px · lg: the footer's 30px
